Subject: Announcement timing and brand permissions — a few clarifying questions

Hi Vivek / Dev,

Thanks for the updated Order Form. Two quick items from our comms and legal teams before we sign:

1) Embargo window — we plan a coordinated press announcement with partners on Oct 6. We need confirmation that Redwood will honor an embargo through Oct 5 (so public announcement on Oct 6 is allowed). If an embargo period is not acceptable, please flag equivalent language we should expect in the Order Form / MSA.

2) Logo & reference use — OptiSecure typically allows vendor logos on partner pages and short case study quotes, but legal is asking whether Redwood requires a perpetual reference right or if a time-limited reference (2 years) is acceptable. Also: any restrictions on how our logo is displayed?

3) Confidentiality carveouts — our legal wants to ensure security milestones or high-level deployment details (region, capacity tier) aren’t required to be disclosed without approval. Can your legal team propose a short exception clause that lets us coordinate approval for any public technical details?

We are looping in our product marketing contact (Maria) in case there are brand asset questions.

Appreciate a short reply with suggested language or redlines so we can keep the sign and announcement schedule.

Thanks,
Sylvia

On Tue, Sep 22, 2026 at 10:35 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attached: OptiSecure_OrderForm_v2_redlines.pdf (redline of the publicity/confidentiality sections)

Thanks — I reviewed the attached and propose the following concrete edits to the publicity and confidentiality provisions. I’m keeping edits tight to avoid opening the rest of the commercial terms.

1) Embargo and announcement approval (new subclause)
Proposed text (pick one):
- Option A (preferred): “Neither party shall issue a public press release or make a public announcement referencing the other party’s Confidential Information, customer relationship, or the business terms of this Agreement prior to the agreed announcement date. Each party shall provide the other with draft press materials at least 5 business days prior to any planned public announcement. The receiving party shall not unreasonably withhold or delay consent to such materials.”
- Option B (shorter): “Each party agrees to an embargo through the agreed announcement date and will provide draft materials at least 3 business days prior to publication for review and approval.”

Recommendation: adopt Option A for clarity; for this deal, we can shorten the review period to 3 business days if OptiSecure needs faster turnaround, but the 5-day window gives both sides time for legal/marketing review.

2) Logo and reference rights (revision)
- Replace broad perpetual reference right with a limited license for: (i) listing the other party’s name and logo on a partners/customers page; (ii) use in a one-page case study or short testimonial. Each use (beyond partner listing) requires prior written approval for the specific materials.
- If OptiSecure prefers a two-year term for logo use, we can accept that with a renewal provision: rights revert to the owner after two years unless renewed in writing.

3) Confidentiality carveout for high-level operational details (new carveout)
Proposed text: “Notwithstanding the confidentiality obligations, the parties may disclose high-level deployment details (e.g., region, capacity tier, and non-sensitive performance metrics) in marketing materials, provided that such disclosures are approved in writing by the disclosing party prior to publication and do not include customer-identifying or security-sensitive configuration details.”

4) Approval mechanics and turnaround
- Add an explicit review window (3–5 business days depending on chosen embargo option) and a mechanism: silence = approval after the window unless express objection is sent. This prevents blocking sign-off the day before the planned announcement.

I attached a short MSA excerpt with inline comments (Redwood_MSA_excerpt_Confidentiality_annotated.docx) and tracked the minimal insertion points.

If OptiSecure is comfortable with Option A but with 3 business days, we can finalize quickly and I can instruct commercial to produce a final Order Form for signature.

Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
